falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 78% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support, and a violation confirms this was not a bottom formation but a breakdown continuation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 38 suggests moderate fear not extreme panic; sustained VIX above 35 indicates capitulation-level stress inconsistent with a bottoming process and signals the pattern has morphed into a deeper correction or crash structure

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A worsening inversion beyond -50bps would signal escalating recession probability that overrides the bottoming pattern; the August 2024 bottom occurred with spread stabilization, and further inversion proves macro deterioration is accelerating not stabilizing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
